blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Cale88 Foods Corporation, the company owned by Vice President Sara Duterte’s spouse, Atty. Manases Carpio, had a change in ownership in 2025 not recorded until an inspection in 2026, a witness said on Friday. Cale88 was flagged by the prosecution for supposedly receiving over P300 million in remittances from China. According to Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary for Industry Development and Promotions Group Ceferino Rodolfo, the Philippine Board of Investments (BOI) discovered the leadership change during an inspection of Cale88’s plant in Tagum City, Davao Del Norte on May 18, 2026. “Nung pagpunta ho kasi natin […]...
